beats.say: Every photo of a receipt you upload to the cloud leaks your name, email, and phone number. PrivRedact fixes that. Watch: I snap an invoice, and the private parts are blacked out on my own device, before anything touches the network. See the badge? On device.

No connection? No problem. The redaction still works, because the small model lives in the browser. The cloud summary waits politely instead of hanging. And if I force cloud-only with no network, it says so. Every answer carries its true badge.

Back online, only the redacted text, never your raw photo, goes to the big model, which returns a clean structured summary: vendor, total, date, next actions. Private by construction, powerful by fallback.
The dashboard proves the hybrid story: every request shows its mode, where it actually ran, and how long it took. Flip the mode, and the badges follow the real route. Never a guess.
Raw PII never left this device. On-device answers cost zero cents and zero latency to the cloud. Try it live at the link below. Built with Firebase AI Logic hybrid inference for Build Hybrid AI 2026.
